question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH purchases AS (
    SELECT visit_id, MIN(event_time) as purchase_time
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3
    GROUP BY visit_id
),
product_interactions AS (
    SELECT e.visit_id, e.page_id, e.event_type, e.event_time,
           h.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy h ON e.page_id = h.page_id
    WHERE h.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
last_interaction_before_purchase AS (
    SELECT pi.product_id, pi.visit_id, pi.event_type, pi.event_time,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pi.visit_id ORDER BY pi.event_time DESC) as rn
    FROM product_interactions pi
    JOIN purchases p ON pi.visit_id = p.visit_id
    WHERE pi.event_time < p.purchase_time
)
SELECT product_id, event_type, COUNT(*) as purchase_count
FROM last_interaction_before_purchase
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY product_id, event_type
ORDER BY product_id
